# netbox_module_bay_template (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox module bay template (`/api/dcim/module-bay-templates/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_module_bay_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_module_bay_template" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/module-bay-templates/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `display` (String) Display.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `module_bay_type_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Module Bay Type (`netbox_module_bay_type`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_type_id` (Number) ID of the Module Type (`netbox_module_type`).
- `position` (String) Identifier to reference when renaming installed components. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
